idea: Handmade scented candles sold on Instagram, made in my hostel room

invented_stats.where: growth.channel:Instagram DM hustle to engaged followers

strategist.problem: A college student in India wants a small, affordable, good-smelling gift or room upgrade for a friend's birthday or hostel room, but local shops only stock generic dhoop and imported candles cost ₹500+ on Amazon.
strategist.target_customer: Indian college students aged 18-24 across metro and tier-2 cities with ₹300-800 of monthly discretionary spend, who already buy aesthetic room decor and gifts through Instagram DMs and UPI.
strategist.mission: Make hand-poured, hostel-made scented candles affordable and Instagram-buyable for Indian students who currently overpay for imported brands.

competitors.name: Local candle brands on Instagram (e.g. small home-candle businesses in Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore)
competitors.differentiator: They price for adult buyers at ₹400-800 plus shipping; we cut to hostel-scale batches and campus pickup to hit student budgets.

competitors.name: Amazon/Flipkart imported and mass-market candles (Yankee Candle, Homecentre, local agarbatti brands)
competitors.differentiator: They win on trust and delivery speed but lose on price, personalization, and the 'made by a student like me' story that shares well in hostel WhatsApp groups.

competitors.name: Homemade candle-making classmates and DIY kits
competitors.differentiator: DIY kits cost more in time and materials than one finished candle; classmates lack consistent scent quality and repeat supply.

scope_cuts: No custom e-commerce website or app — sell through Instagram DMs plus Razorpay payment links until 50 orders prove demand.
No subscription or monthly candle box — one-time gift and room-use purchases only, since student budgets are irregular.
No wholesale to shops or corporate gifting in the first 6 weeks — direct campus buyers only, to keep inventory and cash simple.

stack.name: Instagram Business account
stack.why: Sell through DMs and Reels where the founder's existing followers already are; free storefront.

stack.name: Razorpay Payment Links
stack.why: UPI payment links sent in Instagram DMs, no website needed, 2% + GST only on paid orders.

stack.name: WhatsApp Business
stack.why: Free app for order confirmation, catalogue, quick replies and shipping updates with buyers.

stack.name: Shiprocket Lite
stack.why: Free plan, ~₹45 per parcel, ships candles pan-India from a hostel room.

stack.name: Google Sheets
stack.why: Free order, inventory and SKU tracker synced with the founder's Google account.

ai_tools.name: Claude
ai_tools.why: Writes product captions, DM reply scripts, SKU descriptions and Reel hooks in Hinglish.

ai_tools.name: ChatGPT
ai_tools.why: Generates scent names, bundle ideas and cost-per-unit calculations from supplier quotes.

ai_tools.name: Canva
ai_tools.why: Free plan makes Instagram post templates, price cards and packaging labels.

ai_tools.name: VN Video Editor
ai_tools.why: Free mobile editor to cut candle-pouring Reels without watermark.

mvp_features: SKU 1: Single 100g soy candle in glass jar, 1 of 3 scents (Vanilla, Sandalwood, Lavender), ₹249 price point set by pricing agent.
SKU 2: Gift pair bundle — two 100g candles in a kraft box with a handwritten note card, for birthdays.
SKU 3: Hostel starter single 50g tin candle, lowest entry price, for room-use trial buyers.

tool_costs.price_note: 2% + GST per payment, no setup fee or AMC. Price checked 2026-11-02 on https://razorpay.com/pricing/
free plan, about Rs 45 per shipment on average. Price checked 2026-11-02 on https://www.shiprocket.in/pricing/

first_10_steps: Message 3 soy wax and 3 fragrance-oil suppliers on IndiaMart and Instagram; collect per-kg quotes and MOQs.
Order ₹2,000 of sample materials: 2kg soy wax, 100ml each of 3 fragrance oils, 10 glass jars, wicks, thermometer.
Pour 6 test candles at home, photograph 3 best in daylight, and post them as an Instagram carousel within 7 days.
DM 20 followers who liked the post asking if they'd pre-order; log yes/no in Google Sheets.
Take 10 pre-orders via Razorpay payment links before buying bulk wax for the first batch.
Buy the first bulk batch (10kg wax, 50 jars, 5 fragrance oils) only after 10 pre-orders confirm.
Set up WhatsApp Business catalogue with the 3 SKUs and quick replies for price, scent and delivery time.
List the 3 SKUs on Shiprocket Lite and run one test parcel to a batchmate to verify ₹45 rate and packaging safety.
Record 3 Reels of the pour-and-pack process using VN Video Editor; schedule 1 per week on Instagram.
Open a Google Sheet order log with columns: date, SKU, UPI ID, shipping status, repeat buyer flag.

pricing.name: Hostel Starter 50g tin candle
features: 50g soy tin candle, 1 scent of 3, self-pickup on campus or ₹45 shipping

pricing.name: Single 100g jar candle
features: 100g soy candle in glass jar, 1 of 3 scents, ₹45 shipping extra or free campus pickup

pricing.name: Gift pair bundle
features: Two 100g candles in kraft box with handwritten note card, ₹45 shipping extra

burn_line_items.item: Marketing budget (₹60 Instagram Boost on 2 Reels + ₹400 bulk wax/jar restock samples)
Hostel room electricity share for pouring (fixed student contribution)

revenue_targets.notes: 10 pre-orders taken, 5 convert to paid after sample batch ships
2 Reels boosted, 3 batchmate resellers in hostel WhatsApp groups
Gift pair bundle lifts avg order; repeat buyers from Day 30 cohort

key_assumptions: Delivery cost per customer = ₹90 goods (wax, jar, wick, fragrance, box) + ₹45 Shiprocket Lite parcel; campus-pickup buyers offset courier buyers.
Avg revenue per customer ₹280 assumes 70% single 100g buyers at ₹249, 20% gift pairs at ₹499, 10% 50g tins at ₹149.
Willingness to pay rests on the strategist's assumption that students spend ₹300-800 monthly on decor and gifts via Instagram DM + UPI.
One purchase per customer per month; repeat purchase rate not yet proven, so MRR targets count only distinct paying buyers.

channels.name: Instagram DM hustle to engaged followers
channels.tactic: DM 15 followers who liked/commented on the last 5 candle posts daily in Hinglish with the cold message + Razorpay link; 120 DMs/month, target 3 buyers.

channels.name: Hostel WhatsApp group seeding
channels.tactic: Post 1 carousel + price card in 6 named hostel/college WhatsApp groups per week (24 posts/month) with campus-pickup offer; target 2 buyers.

first_10_customers: Day 1-2: List 40 followers who liked your last 5 candle posts in Google Sheets; DM all 40 with the cold message.
Day 3-5: Hand-deliver 3 free 50g test candles to hostel floor-mates who reply yes; ask each for a Story tag.
Day 6-8: Post their Story reposts + your carousel into 6 named hostel and class WhatsApp groups with campus-pickup price.
Day 9-12: Send Razorpay payment links to every 'price?' reply within 10 minutes; log yes/no in Google Sheets.
Day 13-16: Offer 2 batchmates a free handwritten note card if they pre-order gift pairs for friends' birthdays.
Day 17-21: Call (not DM) the 5 warmest replies personally to close the last 3 of the 10.
growth.cold_message:
Hey! I hand-pour soy candles in my hostel room — Vanilla, Sandalwood, Lavender at ₹249 (₹149 for the 50g tin), free pickup on campus.
I'm taking 10 pre-orders this week only; want me to hold one for you?
I'll send a Razorpay UPI link and a photo of your actual candle before I pour it.

objections.objection: "I can get candles cheaper on Amazon."
objections.response: ₹249 here is a 100g soy jar with your choice of 3 scents, poured this week, free campus pickup — Amazon's ₹200 options are 30g paraffin with no scent choice.

objections.objection: "How do I know it'll smell good / arrive safe?"
objections.response: I'll send a photo of your exact candle plus a 10-second sniff-test Reel before shipping, and I re-ship free if the jar arrives cracked.

critic.verdict: The plan is a coherent, constraint-honest campus-first candle business: physical product, sourcing steps, UPI/Razorpay payments, and a savings-sized budget all line up with the HARD RULES. Pricing (₹149-499) sits plausibly in the stated student discretionary range, and the DM + WhatsApp + campus-pickup motion is realistic for a student founder. The main gaps are in growth realism and a missing repeat-purchase story, but nothing that would strand the founder.
critic.biggest_risk: Repeat purchase rate is unproven and all revenue targets count only distinct new buyers — if one-time gift buyers don't come back, the ₹7,000 Day-90 target depends entirely on continuous cold DM conversion, which is fragile at 15 hours/week.
